mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(operation='KNOWLEDGE_USAGE_SHOWN'),0) shown_count, COALESCE(SUM(operation='KNOWLEDGE_USAGE_ADOPTED'),0) adoption_count, COALESCE(SUM(operation='KNOWLEDGE_USAGE_EFFECTIVE'),0) effective_count, COALESCE(SUM(operation='KNOWLEDGE_USAGE_INEFFECTIVE'),0) ineffective_count, MAX(CASE WHEN operation LIKE 'KNOWLEDGE_USAGE_%' THEN event_time END) last_used_at FROM t_system_audit_log WHERE target_type='KNOWLEDGE' AND target_id=#{targetId}
